purpose: Temporary local diagnostic indexing only. No book text is committed; this manifest holds metadata and hashes only.
selectionCriteria: PO-051 feasibility gate: the closest ten-book authentic Spanish cohort to the governing fixture (20 M code points) under maxChunksPerBook = 2,000 and the ten-book limit. Candidates were a bounded, named list of 22 long public-domain Spanish novels already identified from the Gutenberg catalogue in PO-050, sized by HTTP Content-Length only (no text downloaded). The ten largest were selected, with at most two works per author for diversity. W01 and W03 were reused from PO-050. Fortunata y Jacinta exceeds the chunk cap; Pío Baroja (died 1956) is not public domain in Spain.
normalizationProcedure: 0) Bytes are used exactly as served (CRLF line endings preserved, as the production fetcher stores them). 1) Verify acquiredSha256. 2) Apply production GutenbergFetcherService.stripHeaders (START/END markers, then trim); verify strippedSha256. 3) Keep code points [keepCodePoints[0], keepCodePoints[1]) (removes the listed editorial material). 4) Remove '[Illustration...]' blocks. 5) Trim. Implemented by services/api/tests/perf/e1-literary-diag.ts prepare.
